title: Cryo's Nuclear Mod
description:
This is an tech mod I made. It does not have any use now and it is very VERY simple, but... It will have.
Note: this mod is free to use in any modpack, but give me credit then.
body:
# Cryo's Nuclear Mod

YEAHH BABEHH!!!! It's finally here! My lazily made mod is now free for everyone to use! Well... there are much things to discover and test. Have fun!
Thank you for downloading or even seeing this. I hope you like it!
You should download this mod if you like lightweight tech mods with random things.
My youtube channel: www.youtube.com/@NikoBRidk

                      -made with <3 by TheCryos
      (Note: this whole mod is purely cosmetic for now)
Summary
- Adds 2 new multiblocks (Nuclear and Nether reactor).


- 3 new materials, Uranium, Lead and Silicon with ore and block variants too.


- Adds a BUNCH of crafting ingredients and recipes that I will NOT list here.


- Now technicall blocks (Nether portal, End portal and End gateway) have item forms.

What I plan to add:

- Working energy and generators

- Automation

- Deco blocks

- Pipes
